literal.prompt: Какой из перечисленных предметов Merriam-Webster определяет как брюки длиной до колена или короче?

literalGroups.primaryGround: Merriam-Webster noun sense 4a explicitly defines shorts as knee-length or shorter trousers (full entry L284-L300). The prompt asks which named item this dictionary entry defines that way; it does not ask whether other garments can physically be cropped. The saved leggings and culotte entries supply different named definitions.
literalGroups.locator: MW SHORT noun sense 4a L284-L300; leggings noun sense 1a L52-L60; culotte definition L42-L46.

literalGroups.literal: Шорты — брюки длиной до колена или короче. Merriam-Webster определяет легинсы как эластичные плотно облегающие брюки, а кюлоты — как разделённую юбку.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The first sentence gives the shorts definition; the second summarizes the distinct source definitions for leggings and culotte (leggings L56; culotte L42-L46).
literalGroups.locator: MW complete entry: noun sense 4a L284-L300 and Kids noun sense 2a L576-L591.; MW complete entry: noun sense 1a L52-L60 and plural form L48.; MW complete entry: definition L31-L46 and Kids definition L92-L102.

literalGroups.literal: Юбка — свободно свисающая одежда, частично или полностью закрывающая тело от талии вниз.
literalGroups.primaryGround: MW defines a skirt as a free-hanging garment covering some or all of the body from the waist down (sense 1a(1), L48). The revised Russian note preserves that lower-body scope.
literalGroups.locator: MW skirt noun sense 1a(1), L44-L50, especially the qualifier “from the waist down” at L48.

literalGroups.literal: Легинсы — эластичные брюки, плотно облегающие ноги.
literalGroups.primaryGround: MW defines leggings as pants made of material stretching to fit tightly around the legs (L56).
literalGroups.locator: MW complete entry: noun sense 1a L52-L60 and plural form L48.

literalGroups.literal: Кюлоты — разделённая юбка или одежда такого типа; название обычно употребляется во множественном числе.
literalGroups.primaryGround: MW defines culotte as a divided skirt or garment having a divided skirt and says it is often plural (L42-L46).
literalGroups.locator: MW complete entry: definition L31-L46 and Kids definition L92-L102.

literalGroups.literal: В словаре shorts помечено как существительное, которое обычно употребляется во множественном числе.
literalGroups.primaryGround: MW defines shorts as knee-length or shorter trousers and labels the noun usually plural (L284-L300); plural usage adds a fact beyond the prompt/key.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: A skirt can itself be short, but this prompt asks which named item Merriam-Webster defines as knee-length-or-shorter trousers. The skirt entry instead defines a free-hanging waist-down garment; this is a dictionary-entry distinction, not a claim that skirts cannot be short.
